item.text: {"recognition":"这是 UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention 数据集。数据集识别和附带元数据不是发现；结果仅适用于本次提供的 session-level 数据。","selected_id":"I3","final":{"status":"revised","candidate":{"id":"I3","title":"Is product-page duration share nonlinearly associated with Revenue?","question":"Among sessions with positive total recorded category duration, does ProductRelated_Duration divided by total recorded category duration show a nonlinear conditional association with Revenue after accounting for total duration, page counts, Month, VisitorType, and TrafficType, excluding PageValues?","core":{"object":"Revenue and product-page share of recorded Administrative, Informational, and ProductRelated duration","relation_or_action":"Estimate a prespecified nonlinear conditional association between product-page duration share and Revenue","contrast":"A nonlinear share term versus a linear share term, using the same adjustment variables and eligible sessions","prediction":"A nonlinear share term will improve out-of-sample log loss over the linear term; the observed decile rates do not support predicting a monotonic direction.","independent_unit":"Session represented by one row"},"failure_condition":"The nonlinear term does not improve held-out log loss under a prespecified split and model, or its estimated pattern is unstable across reasonable specifications.","assumptions":["The three duration measures are comparable enough to define their sum and a product-page share; this measurement meaning is not established by the bundle.","Sessions with zero total recorded duration are excluded, and conclusions apply only to eligible sessions.","Adjustment describes conditional association and does not establish that changing time allocation changes conversion.","The split and nonlinear model are fixed before evaluating held-out results."],"required_new_data":["Documentation confirming whether the three duration fields represent comparable, non-overlapping time; event-level timestamps would be needed to establish temporal ordering relative to purchase intent or transaction."],"feasible_with_current_data":true,"domain_value":"Tests whether the recorded allocation of browsing duration contains descriptive information beyond total duration and page counts, and whether a simple linear summary is inadequate.","history_match":"I2","history_relation":"refinement","discriminating_delta":"Prior candidates examined product dwell per page and its VisitorType interaction. This candidate examines the share of recorded category duration and compares nonlinear with linear association; it does not claim a causal reallocation effect.","quality_gate":{"specific":true,"testable":true,"coherent_feasible":true,"worth_testing":true},"next_action":"test"},"evidence_level":"computed_feasibility","what_changed":"The actual compute return found 720 of 12,330 sessions with zero total recorded category duration, leaving 11,610 eligible sessions (9,705 Revenue=False; 1,905 Revenue=True). Revenue rates across equal-count product-share deciles were nonmonotonic, so I removed the proposed directional prediction and revised the question to test nonlinearity. No adjusted model, uncertainty estimate, or held-out comparison was returned; feasibility summaries do not establish an association.","what_is_known":"In compute_0, product-share decile conversion rates ranged from about 0.049 to 0.250 and did not change monotonically. The share's correlation with total duration was about 0.066; its correlations with Administrative, Informational, and ProductRelated page counts were about -0.394, -0.232, and 0.118. These summaries do not establish adequate conditional overlap across categorical covariates or support for an adjusted estimate. The duration fields' measurement comparability and timing are unresolved.","new_hypothesis":"The product-page duration share may have a nonlinear descriptive association with Revenue, but the supplied feasibility summaries neither confirm that relationship nor distinguish it from confounding, measurement structure, or selection into positive-duration sessions.","next_falsifiable_test":"On eligible sessions, compare prespecified linear and restricted-spline product-share terms in otherwise identical models with the stated adjustment variables, excluding PageValues. Use a fixed session-level held-out split; report held-out log loss, uncertainty appropriate to the split design, overlap, and sensitivity to the zero-duration exclusion. No improvement or an unstable pattern would fail the nonlinear-association prediction.","nearest_work_comparison":"The supplied history includes questions about ProductRelated_Duration per ProductRelated page and its interaction with VisitorType. This proposal changes the focal measure to a category-duration share and tests functional form, but remains related to those prior duration–Revenue questions. The bundle contains no current-round literature search result, so literature novelty is unverified.","novelty_status":"Literature novelty unverified; history-relative difference is a refinement of earlier duration–Revenue candidates, not a demonstrated new family.","feedback_type":"uncertainty"}}}
